messages.message:
Patch Set 6:

(1 comment)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. One structural note on the series: ext4-pdirop.patch now drops the `#define ext4_add_entry(...)` compat macro and converts ext4_add_nondir(), ext4_mkdir(), __ext4_link() and ext4_rename() to ext4_add_entry_locked(), and ext4-give-warning-with-dir-htree-growing.patch then converts all four back. Keeping the macro in pdirop (as the pre-7.1 patches did) would leave those four call sites untouched by both patches and avoid the churn that the __ext4_link() hunk got wrong.

commit.message:
LU-20373 ldiskfs: server support for v7.1

Linux commit v7.0-rc1-12-g0b2600f81cefc
  treewide: change inode->i_ino from unsigned long to u64
Adjust patches to use %llu for i_ino

Linux commit v7.0-rc4-29-geb10607628acd
  ext4: remove unused i_fc_wait
trivial patch conflict due to changed context

Linux commit v7.0-rc4-32-gaf1502f98e2cd
  ext4: simplify mballoc preallocation size rounding for small files
mballoc patches need adjustment

Linux commit v7.0-rc4-40-g2879374604b72
  ext4: split __ext4_add_entry() out of ext4_add_entry()
Adjustments to dirdata, pdirop, dir-htree-growing, also affects
dirdata lustre-compat d_fsdata -> i_dirdata slightly, ensure
i_dirdata is initialized on the new inode paths.

Linux commit v7.0-rc4-42-g52b4fea162dd3
  ext4: move dcache manipulation out of __ext4_link()
Adjustments to dir-htree-growing need to handle case when
dentry could be NULL

Linux commit v7.0-rc6-4-g14a51045e10d3
  get rid of busy-waiting in shrink_dcache_tree()
trivial changes accessing d_alias in struct dentry.

Update patches for:
  ext4-dir-entry-len.patch
  ext4-dirdata-core.patch
  ext4-dirdata-lustre-compat.patch
  ext4-give-warning-with-dir-htree-growing.patch
  ext4-hash-indexed-dir-dotdot-update.patch
  ext4-kill-dx-root.patch
  ext4-lookup-dotdot.patch
  ext4-mballoc-pa-free-mismatch.patch
  ext4-pdirop.patch
  ext4-prealloc.patch

NOTE ext4-dirdata-core.patch incorporates fix from:
     ("LU-20424 ldiskfs: save dirdata in ext4_htree_store_dirent")

Test-Parameters: trivial
